claim_statement_pin: Sheaf/cohomological obstruction measures may identify cross-source climate-data inconsistencies or coverage defects not captured as efficiently by simpler graph and residual diagnostics.
realization_rule: Reference-realized obligations are independent correctness oracles only. Production climate-data obligations are discharged only by canonical-realized or validated implementations whose witnesses include canonical source. Open production obligations prevent the method from being described as realized climate-data sheaf/cohomology.

obligations.statement: A finite simplicial complex and cochain groups over an explicit coefficient field are constructed from declared simplices.
Coboundary maps are linear over the coefficient field and satisfy d_(k+1) o d_k = 0 on the reference complex.
Betti numbers are computed as dimensions of cohomology groups and agree with known finite-complex fixtures.
For a declared finite cover of a discrete support set, nerve simplices are constructed exactly from non-empty common intersections.
A finite cellular sheaf can carry non-constant finite-dimensional stalks with explicit restriction maps whose composition is checked as a hard invariant.

For the finite cellular reference, local assignments are compatible exactly when they lie in ker(d^0), and the global-section-space dimension is computed from that kernel rather than from a merge heuristic.

The canonical real cellular-sheaf operator applies degree-zero restrictions and L0=d0^T d0 without requiring dense global assembly, exports sparse coboundary entries for library backends, and retains bounded dense spectral diagnostics only for verification fixtures.

For one real rank-one identity-restriction edge, the compatibility energy expands to the scalar graph quadratic form, is invariant under edge-orientation reversal, and is zero if and only if the endpoint values agree; these statements are kernel-checked in Lean without project-authored axioms or proof escape hatches.

Provider-backed station vertices form a declared global-geodesic locality complex whose edges use indexed WGS84 neighborhoods and whose requested higher simplices are generated from sparse local adjacency rather than arbitrary tuples or a global powerset.

A provider-neutral station section carries explicit variable identities, units, observed/missing masks, and canonical same-variable identity restrictions over local station edges without imputing unavailable observations.
Canonical higher-dimensional climate stalks and nontrivial restriction maps satisfy identity and composition laws on the production locality complex.

The canonical station degree-zero coboundary is assembled as sparse CSR or applied locally without dense global materialization, with deterministic structural row identity under observation missingness.
Canonical sparse higher-degree climate cochain differentials are assembled from production restriction maps and satisfy d_(k+1) o d_k = 0 without dense global matrices or global tuple enumeration.

Climate-data compatibility, global-section existence/nullspace structure, and any reconstruction/gluing semantics are computed through scalable sparse or matrix-free operators on the actual canonical restrictions; incompatibility is not silently merged away.
Known-topology, injected-fault, withheld-data, and negative-control experiments test whether the sheaf quantities detect what they claim to detect.
Task-scoped real-data evaluation demonstrates incremental value, if any, over graph residual, QC, interpolation, and other declared baselines.
